t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Melora
d: After failing in love with a woman whose species is unable to walk in "normal" gravity, Bashir develops a technology that could free her of her wheelchair forever.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Playing God
d: While hosting her first Trill initiate, Dax discovers a tiny, developing universe, which threatens to destroy the station as it expands.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Blood Oath
d: Dax risks her life and her future with Starfleet to fulfill a blood oath made with three aged Klingons.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Crossover
d: A mishap in the wormhole sends Kira and Bashir into an alternate universe where Bajor is a tyrannical power and humans are slaves.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The House Of Quark
d: In order to boost his business and gain respect, Quark lies about killing a Klingon, then winds up forced to marry the dead man's widow.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Civil Defense
d: A trapped crew fights to save the station from self-destruction when an automated Cardassian security program is accidentally activated.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Through The Looking Glass
d: In a parallel universe, Sisko must assume the role of his dead counterpart in order to save the mirror version of his late wife.
With a war raging, Kirk and Spock battle Klingons to free Organia.

t: Star Trek: Voyager: Barge Of The Dead
d: B’Elanna struggles with questions of the afterlife and her Klingon heritage.
B’Elanna is strangely disturbed by her unborn child’s Klingon traits.
A group of Klingons separated from the rest of their race believes B’Elanna’s unborn child is the Savior foretold in their sacred scrolls.
The Enterprise crew becomes embroiled in a local power struggle on a tribal planet.
The Enterprise is overrun by furry creatures while tangling with Klingons and bureaucrats.
Kirk becomes involved in an arms race when the Klingons equip a native people with superior weaponry.
The Enterprise must escort an alien princess to her marriage to seal an interplanetary alliance. In their journey, she becomes attracted to Kirk.
Kirk, McCoy, and Sulu are stranded on a barren planet where a mysterious woman attempts to kill them one at a time, while the Enterprise must travel halfway across the galaxy to rescue them.
Kirk and Spock meet Abraham Lincoln and Surak of Vulcan and must battle with some of history's most terrible villains.
